verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Notion supports comments as a first-class object: the REST API can read and create comments, and webhooks fire on new comments. Nothing in the pack shows comments anchored to specific text spans or images within a page's content, so the core of this story is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of inline comments anchored to selected text, comments on images, UI-level evidence of the commenting experience, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
